0.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_MOBOFFICER_000_000
0.description: The marks posted on the Hunt board are not for the faint of heart or slow of sword-arm. Only those of proven ability to dodge death need apply.

3.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_A1_000_001
3.description: Tell me about the regular mark bill.

5.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_A1_000_002
5.description: Tell me about the elite mark bill.

8.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_MOBOFFICER_000_002
8.description: The Hunt is Grand Company business. The billmaster of your company is the person to speak with, if you would know more of the Hunt.

9.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_MOBOFFICER_000_010
9.description: There are many beasts in our fair land, some more troublesome than others. It is they who are marked for the Hunt, and a bill for these miscreants displayed for all to note.

10.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_011
10.description: Any bill taken from the Hunt board can be found in the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Key Items<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu.

11.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_012
11.description: Bills are replaced each day at <hex:0206020103><hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time). Bills in your Key Items are valid even after this time, and you will be paid the reward upon slaying the mark.

12.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_013
12.description: Bills may be discarded at will. Any discarded bill can be reacquired from the Hunt board if it has not yet been replaced.

13.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_014
13.description: All rewards placed on marks are paid in full once the mark has been slain.

14.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_MOBOFFICER_000_020
14.description: The more notorious and dangerous among marks are designated elite marks, with a special bill to match. A lone hunter will not suffice for these ravening prey, I fear. Take a friend─take many friends─unless you've long nursed a great desire to find your eternal rest in some creature's gullet. The gods know there are better ways to die.

15.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_021
15.description: Elite marks are ranked according to the risk they pose: rank B (lowest risk), rank A, and rank S (highest risk). Rank B marks are always present somewhere afield, while rank A and rank S marks will only appear under certain conditions.

16.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_022
16.description: The higher the rank, the more difficult the mark is to defeat. However, the quantity of Allied Seals given in reward is correspondingly higher. Moreover, a greater contribution will result in an even greater reward.

17.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_023
17.description: Being the most notorious of foes, rank A and rank S marks will yield rewards when and wheresoever you slay them. To claim rewards for rank B marks, on the other hand, you must possess an elite mark bill for the beast in question. You are therefore encouraged to check the Hunt board before pursuing one of these foes.

18.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_026
18.description: Every hamlet has a hunter-scholar, well versed in the Raimdelle Codex. It would be wise to speak with them before setting off on the Hunt.

19.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_MOBOFFICER_000_025
19.description: There are many beasts in our fair land, some more troublesome than others. The more notorious and dangerous among marks are designated elite marks, with a special bill to match.

20.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_100_030
20.description: Any bill taken from the Hunt board can be found in the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Key Items<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu.

21.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_025
21.description: Elite mark bills are similar to regular bills except for how often they are replaced. A new elite mark bill will appear weekly on <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).

22.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_101_030
22.description: Elite mark bills apply to rank B elite marks. Though these marks are always present somewhere afield, slaying them under normal circumstances will afford you no special rewards.

23.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_102_030
23.description: To claim a reward for slaying a rank B mark, you must have in your possession an elite mark bill issued for the foe in question.

24.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_MOBOFFICER_000_030
24.description: Allied Seals are a mark of honor the Alliance bestows upon those deemed worthy. However, if you would prefer to exchange them for more worldly rewards, you need only see me.

25.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_031
25.description: Allied Seals are acquired by slaying rank A or rank S elite marks, or any marks featured in a bill.

26.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_032
26.description: The seals may be taken to Hunt billmasters associated with your current Grand Company and traded for items. The choice of items available for trade will vary slightly among Grand Companies.

27.name: TEXT_COMDEFMOBOFFICER_00180_SYSTEM_000_033
27.description: Allied Seals are not affected in any way by a change in Grand Company affiliation.
